cases.oracle: Independent x86-64 UAPI encoding, SHA-256 request binding and controlled seccomp replies, with real owned child wait, PTY modes and parent identity. No verifier executes or authenticates in the synthetic acknowledgement case.
cases.comparison: Setup independently constructs AUTHZ and EXEC_VERIFY, rejects a mutated digest, and validates both success and EACCES synthetic replies. On an owned PTY, require failed verifier launch to abort; after a synthetic success acknowledgement require the client to reauthorize the same digest and fail closed on denial or a repeated authentication-required reply. Assert no command marker or handoff, unchanged parent UID/EUID and restored PTY modes. The success reply does not replace the child with a real verifier and cannot establish successful credential verification or an authorized command. Listener bootstrap is precompiled and sends its listener before supervised operations; diagnostic stage files record the handoff. The source-review ownership and embedded-payload guard repairs are included.
cases.purpose: Fail closed on synthetic verifier failure and reauthorization denial for doas.
